mutations.name: S1 the roster check on `to` is dropped, so a DM to an id nobody holds goes to the wire instead of being refused with the id named
mutations.find: if (!onRoster(to)) throw new BadRequest(`no agent with id ${quoteForOperator(to)} is on the roster`);
mutations.expectRed: 4.3 an unknown `to` is refused with 400, naming it escaped
mutations.cell: 4.3 an unknown `to` is refused with 400, naming it escaped

mutations.name: S2 the channel is no longer checked against the name the wire uses, so a name the wire would rewrite posts to a different channel than it names
mutations.expectRed: 4.2 a channel name the wire would rewrite is refused with 400, naming it escaped
mutations.cell: 4.2 a channel name the wire would rewrite is refused with 400, naming it escaped

mutations.name: S3 the wildcard refusal is dropped, so a wildcard reaches the publish and comes back as a broker refusal instead of the caller's mistake
mutations.find: if (name.includes("*") || name.includes(">")) throw new BadRequest(`${quoteForOperator(name)} is not one channel`);
mutations.expectRed: 4.1 a wildcard channel is refused with 400, naming it as more than one channel
mutations.cell: 4.1 a wildcard channel is refused with 400, naming it as more than one channel

mutations.name: S4 the send route is left out of the body routes, so the pre-dispatch guard refuses every post as a body the route does not take
mutations.expectRed: 2.1 a channel post answers 200 and reaches the subscriber from the operator
mutations.cell: 2.1 a channel post answers 200 and reaches the subscriber from the operator

mutations.name: S5 the request frame does not know a broker refusal, so it answers 500 and reads as the dashboard breaking
mutations.expectRed: 2.4 a channel post the broker refuses answers 502 with the broker's message
mutations.cell: 2.4 a channel post the broker refuses answers 502 with the broker's message

mutations.name: S6 a refused channel publish is not wrapped, so it reaches the frame as a server fault
mutations.expectRed: 2.4 a channel post the broker refuses answers 502 with the broker's message
mutations.cell: 2.4 a channel post the broker refuses answers 502 with the broker's message

mutations.name: S7 a refused DM publish is not wrapped, so it reaches the frame as a server fault
mutations.expectRed: 2.5 a DM the broker refuses answers 502 with the broker's message
mutations.cell: 2.5 a DM the broker refuses answers 502 with the broker's message

mutations.name: S8 the expiry check is dropped, so an expired operator tries to start and the post fails as a broker refusal instead of saying to restart
mutations.find: if (poster.expired()) return { status: 403, body: { error: POST_OFF_EXPIRED } };
mutations.expectRed: 1.1 an expired operator credential refuses the post with 403 and POST_OFF_EXPIRED, before the poster starts
mutations.cell: 1.1 an expired operator credential refuses the post with 403 and POST_OFF_EXPIRED, before the poster starts

mutations.name: S9 a post during shutdown is answered as a broker refusal, though the broker refused nothing
mutations.find: if (why === POSTER_STOPPED) return { status: 503, body: { error: why } };
mutations.expectRed: 1.2 a post after the poster stopped answers 503 with POSTER_STOPPED
mutations.cell: 1.2 a post after the poster stopped answers 503 with POSTER_STOPPED

mutations.name: S10 an operator that cannot start is rethrown as it came, so the frame answers it as a server fault
mutations.expectRed: 1.3 an operator that cannot start is a broker refusal, carrying the broker's message
mutations.cell: 1.3 an operator that cannot start is a broker refusal, carrying the broker's message

mutations.name: S11 a channel post drops its mentions, so an agent named in the text is not woken by it
mutations.expectRed: 2.2 the post carries the @mentions in its text, as the wake hint
mutations.cell: 2.2 the post carries the @mentions in its text, as the wake hint

mutations.name: S12 the text is not trimmed, so a post of only whitespace goes out as an empty message
mutations.expectRed: 4.4 an empty text is refused with 400
mutations.cell: 4.4 an empty text is refused with 400

mutations.name: S13 a dashboard whose posting is off is not refused at the route, so a --creds post fails as a server fault with no reason
mutations.find: if (post.mode === "off") return { status: 403, body: { error: post.reason } };
mutations.expectRed: 3.4 a --creds dashboard refuses a post with 403 and POST_OFF_CREDS
mutations.cell: 3.4 a --creds dashboard refuses a post with 403 and POST_OFF_CREDS

mutations.name: S14 a DM answers without the sequence it was stored at, the broker's only proof that it kept the message
mutations.expectRed: 3.2 a DM answers with the sequence the broker stored it at, and a channel post with none
mutations.cell: 3.2 a DM answers with the sequence the broker stored it at, and a channel post with none

mutations.name: S15 the poster starts before the request is checked, so a refused post still puts the operator on the roster
mutations.find: let target: { channel: string } | { to: string };
mutations.replace:
await poster.ensure().catch(() => undefined);
  let target: { channel: string } | { to: string };
mutations.expectRed: 1.4 a refused request never starts the poster, so the operator does not join the roster for a post that did not go out
mutations.cell: 1.4 a refused request never starts the poster, so the operator does not join the roster for a post that did not go out

mutations.name: S16 a body that is not a JSON object is destructured anyway, so the route throws a TypeError and answers 500
mutations.find: if (typeof body !== "object" || body === null || Array.isArray(body)) throw new BadRequest("the request body must be a JSON object");
mutations.expectRed: 4.6 a body that is not a JSON object is refused with 400
mutations.cell: 4.6 a body that is not a JSON object is refused with 400

mutations.name: S17 the operator posts without registering presence, so the roster never shows who the post came from
mutations.expectRed: 2.3 after it, /api/roster lists the operator and /api/meta reports the operatorId the post answered with
mutations.cell: 2.3 after it, /api/roster lists the operator and /api/meta reports the operatorId the post answered with
